title: dryopteris borreri
intro: Dryopteris borreri, commonly known as the Rigid Buckler Fern, is a type of perennial fern species native to Europe, western Asia, and northwestern Africa. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris borreri include its potential to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
